result:
I've fixed the perf harness and updated the docs for round 259 (C-R258-01). `npm run test:perf` now passes again: exit code 0, all 3 specs in 15.2 minutes, and every budget row passes. `app/` and the protected files are untouched, and there's no STOP and no extra locator fix (H6).

**Changes (7 files):**
- `perf/lib/page.ts`: the Play button is found by its exact name `Play`. Playing is read from its `data-playing` attribute instead of the old `Pause` label, and audio still has to be running.
- `perf/studio-lab-interactions.perf.spec.ts`: the range drag looks up the new title `… click = insert marker`.
- `perf/budgets.json` and `perf/budgets.interactions.json`: only the `note` text changed. A `jq` diff with `note` removed is identical to HEAD.
- Docs 163 and 168: the granted sections now describe `data-playing` and no longer mention Pause.
- New doc `194-perf-harness-playing-signal.md`: the seven template headings and the exact status line, plus my real run results.

**Checks I ran:**
- No stale `Pause` or `click = playhead` text is left anywhere in `perf/`.
- `npm run typecheck` passes. It is the only real check for `perf/`, because Biome only covers `app/`.
- `npm run lint` passes; its 205 warnings are all in unchanged `app/` code.
- **Perf run:**
  - all three reports are complete, with 6/6 passes each, no aborts, page errors or failures;
  - every assert row passes (92/92, 17/17, 15/15);
  - both audio-running checks (`harness.audio-running`, `interact.harness.audio-running`) = 1;
  - track, group and master faders show 0 graph restarts while playing, at most 1 component per move (budget 3) and 1 commit on release, at both 1× and 6× speed.

**Caveat on the perf run:** no other tests, builds or browser jobs ran alongside it, but my doc edits, a few greps and the read-only code reviewer did. Every budget passed, so I kept the result rather than re-running.

**Code review:** the `code-reviewer` subagent found no Critical, High or Medium issues and scored the change 9/10. I fixed both Lows in doc 194: it now has real results and corrected Georgian wording. One info note goes to B: the perf specs store `isPlaying()` under the name `detail.contextRunning`, which is now slightly misleading; changing it was outside this round. There was no Architecture note.

**Left for C:** the browser check of the Play signal at both viewports, its own perf run, the comparison script against round 225 (I made no claim about the component-count drift), the auth check, and the gate rows.

The report is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-259.md`. My perf log and report copies are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-259/`.
